provider: Xiaomi MiMo Open Platform (overseas account, pay-as-you-go API)
notes: Prices copied from the API Pricing page (update time 2026-09-22); limits from the Models and Rate Limit pages (update times 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-21). Re-read the pages before any run.
Cache hit: a request prefix that hits the prompt cache is billed at cache_hit. Cache write: free for a limited time. The pages state no cache lifetime and no minimum prefix length.

Batch API: 50% of the real-time price, cache hits billed at the batch cache_hit price, completion window 24 h through the API (1-14 days in the console), at most 128 MB per JSONL file, only successful requests billed, no in-job retry. Needs real-name verification and a prepaid balance.
Thinking is enabled by default for both models; reasoning tokens are billed as output (max_completion_tokens counts them). With thinking enabled, temperature and top_p are fixed at 1.0 and 0.95.
RPM and TPM are per account and model, summed over all API keys of the account.
The Token Plan subscription is a separate quota for AI programming tools; it cannot pay for the Batch API and is not modelled here.
